aromas.note: The official Apple Fritter S1 product page is not used to generalize parent-cut aroma claims to the complete S1 line.

terpenes.note: The official Apple Fritter S1 product page does not provide a cultivar-specific lot terpene profile or COA for the S1 line.

origin.note: The official Apple Fritter S1 page does not state the S1 line's exact creation location; no inferred location is added.

history.note: The official Apple Fritter S1 page does not provide a sufficiently bounded cultivar-specific release chronology for this atlas entry; no secondary history is imported.
